lifecycle.public: Odyssey.init(root): root + descendants; safe to repeat; document delegated legacy handlers; wire:after reinitializes target subtree.
lifecycle.extensions: OdysseyExtensions.init(root), also called by Odyssey.init when loaded; native elements remain usable without JS.
lifecycle.rust: Server-rendered semantic primitives; Wire/Spark are separate opt-in internal runtime. Public enhancer is not implied by APP_CSS.
lifecycle.composition: OdysseyCompositions.init(root) or mountWorkspace(form, adapter); state/authorization/source owned by host.
lifecycle.workflows: Optional workflows.js: OdysseyWorkflows.init(root, optionsByKind), mountTask/mountAuth/mountWizard/mountQueue/mountAccess; explicit host adapters; controllers expose state and destroy.
lifecycle.dataTools: Optional data-tools.js: OdysseyDataTools.init(root), mountFilters/mountText/mountCalendar/mountResources/mountVirtualList/mountPlot; host-owned identity and datasets; explicit state and destroy.
